label: Security
title: Security
intro: Control who can see and operate this telescope. Until the first account exists, anyone who can reach astrolol has full access.
insecure: This connection is not encrypted. Passwords and sessions can be read by anyone on the network. Use HTTPS (see the deployment guide).
open: Security is off: anyone who can reach astrolol can operate the telescope and change its settings. Create the first account to turn sign-in on.
adminOnly: Only admins can manage users, tokens and origins.

first.title: Create the first account
first.hint: The first account is an admin. Signing in is required for everyone as soon as it exists.
first.create: Create account and turn security on

guest.title: Guest access
guest.hint: Let people look without a password. Guests see every screen but cannot change anything.

users.title: Users
users.hint: Read-only users observe. Operators run the telescope and sequences. Admins also change settings, plugins and equipment.
users.name: User name
users.lastAdmin: The only admin cannot be demoted or deleted.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.hint: Tokens let other tools call the API without a password.
tokens.created: Copy this token now — it will not be shown again.
tokens.name: Token name

origins.title: Allowed origins
origins.hint: Web pages served from these addresses may call the API from another site, using a token. One per line.

manifest.name: Security
manifest.description: Sign-in, read-only guest access, API tokens and allowed origins.
